ms.promise:
・The dapp architecture is internally designed and documented in the project’s GitHub repo. The dapp architecture is a concise documentation containing an overall description of the complete dapp web functionality we are going to develop and deliver after M5. The architecture documentation describes the needed components and how they are going to interact with each other, but no code is part of this document. Only the description.
・Development of the initial and untested version of the full web dapp code (without smart contracts). The draft front end code from M2 is further developed and new back end code that can be run on a web server is developed according to the architecture documentation. This version of the dapp is not tested. Buttons might only display a message instead of actually doing anything and dialogs might be empty. The main goal is to have an initial dapp ready to connect with the smart contracts we start to develop in M4.
ms.criteria:
・Version 1.0 of the dapp architecture published on the project’s Github page.
・Initial version of the dapp code is published to the project’s GitHub page. Initial code means that UX/UI design “look and feel” have been implemented and buttons either display real content or at least a message box that this is not yet available. Everything interacting with the smart contracts will only display errors or simply be circumvented as the smart contracts aren’t started before M4.
